final: WITH item_town AS (SELECT c.town_city AS town, il.order_item_id, AVG(il.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * il.derived_product_cost / il.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items il JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = il.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE il.product_price IS NOT NULL AND il.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND il.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND il.derived_total_cost <> 0 GROUP BY il.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_avg AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS average_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS cross_town_average FROM town_avg) SELECT ta.town, ta.average_price, ta.average_ratio, ta.average_ratio - overall.cross_town_average AS above_cross_town_average FROM town_avg ta CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ta.average_ratio > overall.cross_town_average
